summary.name: Sand-on-Light-Table Animation, Drawing and Illustration category. Extracted and added in the 2026-10-12 repository sync.
summary.visualIdentity: A backlit warm light table shows dark granular sand silhouettes, scraped negative-space lines and changing sand density. Explicitly, light shines through thin sand and gaps, not a white page.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to sand-like silhouette animation where shapes form, thin, get scraped and transition. Inferred: tactile, illuminated explainers. Subject, audience and copy are unspecified.
summary.limitations: This is an illustrative granular look, not sand physics. Check grain for flicker and banding. Source stills (1–8 s sampled, medium confidence) show no scrape lines or backlight through gaps. Stop-motion photography is unavailable.
summary.palette: The background is scene-dependent; #F5E3B5 is only an illustrative swatch, not a required canvas. Foreground #3A291B gives 10.931:1 on it, meeting the 4.5 normal-text target. Gradients are disabled. No exact approved colors were supplied, so textured or transmitted-light areas need composited checks.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Sand thins, a scrape line cuts through, then the shape morphs into the next form. GSAP tweens morph, scrape and pour radius on a paused timeline. The 3 s preview is one example; full videos chain more mask pairs. Keep sharp cuts and reading holds. HTML interaction is unspecified.
